tasks.name: Notebook-Ingester
tasks.purpose: Autonomous knowledge base indexer. Traverses markdown sources and notes, builds full-text search indexes in SQLite FTS5 for zero-token retrieval, and verifies source size ceilings.

tasks.name: KB-Sentinel
tasks.purpose: Knowledge base health & drift sentinel. Audits links, validates frontmatter schemas against canonical whitelists, and applies deterministic self-healing fixes.

tasks.name: TRM-Bot
tasks.purpose: Autonomous TRM gap triage engine. Reads actionable research gaps, executes local SQLite FTS5 context queries, and drafts structured RFC decision notes with evidence.

tasks.name: Watchlist-Miner
tasks.purpose: Watchlist & competitor drift miner. Probes external web targets using SHA-256 and ETag diffing to detect structural landscape and technology changes.

tasks.name: Daemon-Healer
tasks.purpose: High-availability daemon supervisor. Monitors ICF Dashboard (port 8080), Sigil Relay (8791), and Sigil Rooms (5173); terminates colliding or hanging processes and restarts services.

tasks.name: CI-Watchdog
tasks.purpose: GitHub Actions failure triage bot. Inspects workflow run telemetry, filters out superseded failures on unmerged commits, and flags persistent CI defects.

tasks.name: Ironbots-Reporter
tasks.purpose: Daily fleet telemetry aggregator. Consolidates health reports across all fleet bots, calculates host heartbeat and fleet health score (0-100), and emits wiki reports.

tasks.name: Storage-Pruner
tasks.purpose: Database and telemetry storage pruner. Vacuums SQLite databases (.kb_cache, snapshots), gzip-compacts historical telemetry logs, and archives completed harness tasks.

tasks.name: TRM-Drive-Sync
tasks.purpose: Two-way transport bridge between local Git repositories and Google Drive. Ingests mobile action cards and completed research, and emits Live Action Receipts.

tasks.name: IronLedger-Sentinel
tasks.purpose: Financial engine supervisor. Audits Docker container health, API endpoints (/healthz, /readyz), balance sheet invariants, and transaction ingestion pipelines.

tasks.name: Daily-Report-Reconciliation
tasks.purpose: Automated 3x daily differential report validator, zombie card cleanser, daemon heartbeat monitor, and gap reconciler.

tasks.name: KB-Sync-Master-Pipeline
tasks.purpose: Master knowledge synchronization orchestrator. Executes staging, offline wiki synthesis, NotebookLM multipart pack cutovers with dedupe gates, drift checks, and gap triage.

tasks.name: KB-Sync-Dashboard-Server
tasks.purpose: Ensures the canonical HTTP telemetry and documentation server is active on port 8080, serving the Warm Parchment / Dark Forge dual-theme dashboard.

tasks.name: KB-Sync-TRM-Triage
tasks.purpose: Executes grounded TRM gap triage with cognitive query expansion directly within the kb-sync pipeline context.

tasks.name: Daily-Roadmap-Sync
tasks.purpose: Multi-repository roadmap synchronization. Enforces roadmap placement rules, audits cross-repo roadmaps, and catches governance drift.

tasks.name: Toolforge-CI-Nightly
tasks.purpose: Automated nightly continuous integration run. Executes test suites, validates skill manifests, and checks dependency graph invariants across all modules.

tasks.name: toolforge-daily-report-agent
tasks.purpose: Compiles the daily developer activity report from commit history, PR deliveries, and automated verification tests over the previous 24 hours.

tasks.name: Toolforge-Drift-Detector
tasks.purpose: Continuous skill and plugin drift detector. Validates installed skills against canonical manifest schemas and automatically repairs minor drift.

tasks.name: toolforge-retro-audit-agent
tasks.purpose: Verifies daily retrospectives, checks test-tag hygiene, audits commit conventions, and validates operational checklists.

tasks.name: toolforge-weekly-report-agent
tasks.purpose: Runs comprehensive weekly retrospective analysis, calculates token efficiencies, and evaluates milestone progress.

tasks.name: toolforge-weekly-report-md-agent
tasks.purpose: Compiles and formats weekly Markdown summary reports into docs/reports/weekly/ for persistent project history.

tasks.name: CIC-Daily-Status
tasks.purpose: Synthesizes daily status of the historical research pipeline, active research questions, and topic extraction status.

tasks.name: CIC-ImageBuild-Daily
tasks.purpose: Daily container build for Cast Iron Charlie ingestion microservices and isolated research containers.

tasks.name: CIC-Mirror-ClaudeMemory
tasks.purpose: Mirrors and backs up Claude Code project memory files and session context files into persistent git-tracked state.

tasks.name: CIC-Nightly-Notebook-Mining
tasks.purpose: Automated nightly query injection and extraction against historical research notebooks (Willow Run, Ford Politics, Willys-Overland).

tasks.name: CIC-Vault-Sync-rl
tasks.purpose: Synchronizes completed historical findings and entity notes into the canonical Obsidian vault.

tasks.name: CIC-WhichLLM-Weekly-Sweep
tasks.purpose: Evaluates inference cost, token latency, and quality benchmarks across configured LLM endpoints to update WhichLLM routing profiles.

tasks.name: CIC-TRM-ClosedLoop-Nightly-Miner
tasks.purpose: Nightly closed-loop research mining. Runs sibling contradiction checks, queries expansion batteries, and consolidates thematic knowledge packs.

tasks.name: toolforge-trm-sync-treatment
tasks.purpose: Synchronizes active research treatments, resolves claimed research tasks, and reconciles treatment logs.

tasks.name: TRM-Notebooklm-Auth-Heartbeat
tasks.purpose: Periodic authentication keep-alive probe for Google NotebookLM. Prevents session timeout and preserves valid auth cookies.

tasks.name: TRM-Notebooklm-Chat-Archive
tasks.purpose: Extracts, parses, and formats interactive NotebookLM chat conversations and grounding citations into permanent markdown archives.

tasks.name: TRM-Notebooklm-Mine
tasks.purpose: Autonomous knowledge mining loop sweeping registered notebooks for emerging topic clusters and research insights.

tasks.name: IronBot-TaskMonitor
tasks.purpose: Supervises running PowerShell and Node background tasks, terminates orphaned processes, and monitors fleet runtime health.

tasks.name: SigilMeshDaemon
tasks.purpose: Runs the local Sigil peer-to-peer mesh relay (port 8791) and streaming WebSocket gateway (port 8793) for federated multi-agent routing.

tasks.name: HelixDaemon
tasks.purpose: Provides local agent execution harness and desktop window automation services for Helix applications.

tasks.name: RewriteLabsDailyBackup
tasks.purpose: Automated backup of RewriteLabs workspaces, static site generator templates, and database state.
